2014_spells.armor-of-agathys.description: A protective magical force surrounds you, manifesting as a spectral frost that covers you and your gear. You gain 5 temporary hit points for the duration. If a creature hits you with a melee attack while you have these hit points, the creature takes 5 cold damage.
2014_spells.armor-of-agathys.effectSumma: Gain temporary hit points for the duration
2014_spells.armor-of-agathys.fullDescrip: Using 1 action, you gain 5 temporary hit points for the duration. If a creature hits you with a melee attack while you have these hit points, the creature takes 5 cold damage; A protective magical force surrounds you, manifesting as a spectral frost that covers you and your gear; When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, both the temporary hit points and the cold damage increase by 5 for each slot level above 1st. The effect lasts for 1 hour.
